# Spells and Magic

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md)*

Casting spells and other magical effects: cantrips, rituals, concentration, attunement, illusions, curses and transformations.

## Entries

- [Attunement](Attunement.md): Some magic items require a creature to form a bond—called Attunement—with them before the creature can use an item's magical properties.
- [Cantrip](Cantrip.md): A cantrip is a level 0 spell, which is cast without a spell slot.
- [Concentration](Concentration.md): Some spells and other effects require Concentration to remain active, as specified in their descriptions.
- [Curses](Curses.md): Some game effects curse a creature or an object.
- [Illusions](Illusions.md): Spells and other effects sometimes create magical illusions.
- [Magical Effect](Magical-Effect.md): An effect is magical if it is created by a spell, a magic item, or a phenomenon that a rule labels as magical.
- [Possession](Possession.md): Some effects cause a creature to be possessed by another creature or entity.
- [Ritual](Ritual.md): If you have a spell prepared that has the Ritual tag, you can cast that spell as a Ritual.
- [Shape-Shifting](Shape-Shifting.md): If an effect, such as Wild Shape or the Polymorph spell, lets you shape-shift, its description specifies what happens to you.
- [Spell](Spell.md): A spell is a magical effect that has the characteristics described in " Spells ".
- [Spell Attack](Spell-Attack.md): A spell attack is an attack roll made as part of a spell or another magical effect.
- [Spellcasting Focus](Spellcasting-Focus.md): A Spellcasting Focus is an object that certain creatures can use in place of a spell's Material components if those materials aren't consumed by the spell and don't have a cost specified.
- [Teleportation](Teleportation.md): Teleportation is a special kind of magical transportation.
